names.official: Tax on wages
names.native: Impozit pe veniturile din salarii

taxes.base: Wages and salaries of employees.

details: A flat personal income tax rate of 10% is generally in place (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 25 September 2026), not checked against the National Agency for Fiscal Administration (ANAF).

instruments.explanation: RON 30.3 billion in 2024: the largest income tax line.

names.official: Tax on income from dividends
names.native: Impozit pe veniturile din dividende

taxes.base: Dividends paid to individuals.

rate.headline: Set by the Fiscal Code
details: As summarised by PwC (review of 25 September 2026), not checked against the National Agency for Fiscal Administration (ANAF).

instruments.explanation: RON 8.0 billion in 2024.

names.official: Tax on pension income
names.native: Impozit pe veniturile din pensii

taxes.base: Pension income above the threshold.

instruments.explanation: RON 5.8 billion in 2024.

names.official: Other personal income taxes: independent activities, rent, interest, non-residents, the unique statement and others
names.native: Alte impozite pe venit (activități independente, chirii, dobânzi, declarația unică, nerezidenți)

taxes.base: The tax on the unique statement (RON 3.2 billion), non-residents (RON 1.4 billion), interest (RON 0.9 billion), other income (RON 0.5 billion), rent (RON 0.4 billion), independent activities, sale of bonds and intellectual rights, agricultural activities and small lines.

rate.headline: 10% generally
details: Thirteen lines in the list.

instruments.explanation: The remaining lines of the personal income tax.

names.official: Tax on profits from economic operators
names.native: Impozit pe profit (operatori economici)

taxes.base: Profit of companies and permanent establishments.

details: The standard CIT rate is 16% for Romanian companies and permanent establishments; nightclubs and gambling pay the higher of 5% of revenue or 16% of profit (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 25 September 2026), not checked against the National Agency for Fiscal Administration (ANAF).

instruments.explanation: RON 32.6 billion in 2024.

names.official: Tax on the income of micro-enterprises
names.native: Impozit pe veniturile microîntreprinderilor

taxes.base: Turnover of small companies that opt for the micro-enterprise regime.

rate.headline: A percentage of turnover
details: The rate is not extracted here.

instruments.explanation: RON 3.4 billion in 2024.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D51B C07 and C08

names.official: Tax on profits from commercial banks
names.native: Impozit pe profitul băncilor comerciale

taxes.base: Profit of commercial banks.

rate.headline: As the corporate rate
details: The turnover tax on credit institutions is a separate line in the sector taxes.

instruments.explanation: RON 3.0 billion in 2024.

names.official: Additional income tax, monopoly tax in electricity and gas, turnover taxes on credit institutions and on other sectors, and the tax on natural resources
names.native: Impozit adițional; taxa pe cifra de afaceri a instituțiilor de credit; taxa de solidaritate

taxes.base: The additional income tax (RON 1.8 billion), the tax on turnover achieved by credit institutions (RON 975 million), a specific tax on turnover of economic agents in a sector (RON 475 million), the monopoly tax in the electricity and gas sector (RON 152 million), revenues from natural resources (RON 98 million) and a small negative line.
taxes.payer: Banks, energy companies and other sectors.

rate.headline: Set by the sector tax laws
details: PwC describes a supplementary turnover tax on credit institutions with rates depending on market share.

instruments.explanation: Six lines.

names.official: Other taxes on profits and dividends of legal persons
names.native: Alte impozite pe profit și dividende

taxes.base: The tax on dividends from legal persons (RON 1,009 million), payments from the net profit of companies (RON 399 million), amounts collected for the State budget in the unique account (RON 174 million) and small lines.

instruments.explanation: Seven lines.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D51B C03–C06, C09, C10, C12

names.official: Taxes on gambling and on revenues from lotteries, gambling and betting, and the tax for the promotion of gambling
names.native: Impozit pe venituri din jocuri de noroc

taxes.base: Gambling (RON 4.3 billion), revenues from lotteries, gambling and betting (RON 1.0 billion) and the promotion tax (RON 12 million).

instruments.explanation: RON 5.4 billion in 2024, about as much as the income tax on pensions. The list books most of it among the taxes on income.

names.official: Employers’ contributions: insurance contribution for work, unemployment, health, accidents, guarantee funds and the contribution for disabled persons
names.native: Contribuția asiguratorie pentru muncă și alte contribuții ale angajatorilor

taxes.base: The insurance contribution for work (RON 5.7 billion, RON 3.7 billion for holidays and allowances), unemployment (RON 2.1 billion), the contribution of legal persons for disabled persons not employed (RON 3.1 billion), state social insurance (RON 0.96 billion) and small lines.

rate.headline: Set by the Fiscal Code
details: The rates are not extracted here.

instruments.explanation: Twelve lines. Since 2018 most of the burden is on the employees’ contributions.

names.official: Social security and health insurance contributions due by the insured
names.native: Contribuții de asigurări sociale (CAS) și de sănătate (CASS) datorate de asigurați

taxes.base: Social security (pension) contributions of the insured (RON 116.5 billion), health insurance contributions (RON 58.8 billion), and small lines.
taxes.payer: Employees, the self-employed and other insured persons.

rate.headline: Set by the Fiscal Code
details: The rates are not extracted here.

instruments.explanation: By far the largest flow in the Romanian list: more than the VAT.

names.official: Value added tax
names.native: Taxa pe valoarea adăugată (TVA)

taxes.base: Goods and services supplied in Romania and imports.
taxes.payer: Consumers; businesses charge it and claim input credits.

rate.headline: 21% standard (19% in 2024); 11% reduced
details: The 21% standard rate applies to all taxable transactions that do not qualify for a reduced rate; the 11% reduced rate applies to medicines, food and beverages (with exceptions) and other goods (PwC, review of 25 September 2026).
The standard rate was 19% in 2024, the year of the revenue; it rose to 21% in 2025.
As summarised by PwC (review of 25 September 2026), not checked against the National Agency for Fiscal Administration (ANAF).

instruments.explanation: RON 119.1 billion: the second-largest flow after the insured persons’ contributions.

names.official: Customs duties and anti-dumping taxes
names.native: Taxe vamale

taxes.base: Goods imported from outside the EU, by the Common Customs Tariff: duties from legal persons (RON 1,259 million), anti-dumping duties (RON 146 million) and small lines.

rate.headline: EU Common Customs Tariff
details: An EU own resource; Eurostat records it under the EU institutions.

instruments.explanation: Collected for the EU budget.

names.official: Excises on energy products and electric energy, domestic and on imports
names.native: Accize pe produse energetice și energie electrică

taxes.base: Energy products sold domestically (RON 19.7 billion) and imported (RON 2.8 billion), and electric energy (RON 0.2 billion).
taxes.payer: Fuel suppliers and importers; passed on at the pump.

rate.headline: Per 1,000 litres
details: The excise duty on unleaded gasoline in force as of 1 January 2026 is RON 3,059.80 per 1,000 litres and on leaded gasoline RON 3,598.98; a temporary dynamic mechanism reduces the diesel excise by up to 25% (PwC).

instruments.explanation: The largest excise.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D214A C03 and C08, D2122C C01

names.official: Excises on tobacco products, domestic and on imports
names.native: Accize pe produse din tutun

taxes.base: Cigarettes and other tobacco products.
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on in the price.

instruments.explanation: RON 20.0 billion on domestic sales: nearly as much as the energy excise.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D214A C05, D2122C C03

names.official: Excises on ethyl alcohol, intermediate products and other products, domestic and on imports
names.native: Accize pe alcool și alte produse

taxes.base: Ethyl alcohol and intermediate products (RON 1.9 billion), other products (RON 0.6 billion) and small import lines.
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on in the price.

rate.headline: Per hectolitre or per unit
details: PwC gives the excise level for beer as RON 5.83 per hectolitre per Plato degree and for intermediate products RON 701.83 per hectolitre (2026).

instruments.explanation: Five lines.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D214A C04 and C07, D2122C C02, C05, C06

names.official: Contributions due for drugs financed from the National Health Insurance Fund (cost-volume contributions)
names.native: Contribuția clawback

taxes.base: As named in the National Tax List: the revenue contribution due for drugs financed from the National Fund (RON 3,393 million, less RON 37 million in a second line) and the revenue from the cost-volume / cost-volume-result contracts (RON 1,783 million).

rate.headline: Set by the health insurance laws
details: Eurostat books these amounts under the social security funds.

instruments.explanation: A levy on drug producers that finances the health insurance fund.

names.official: Contribution to the Modernization Fund, income from the contribution to the Energy Transition Fund and environmental fees
names.native: Fondul pentru modernizare; Fondul pentru tranziție energetică

taxes.base: The Modernization Fund (RON 5.3 billion), the Energy Transition Fund (RON 4.5 billion) and environmental fees (RON 26 million).

rate.headline: Set by the fund laws
details: The revenue from the sale of emission permits (RON 2.8 billion) is not counted.

instruments.explanation: Three lines that Eurostat books under central government.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D29F C01 and C03, D29H C09

names.official: Other taxes and fees, and special fees, State part
names.native: Alte taxe și impozite; taxe speciale (partea statului)
names.common: Other taxes and fees: State part

taxes.base: As named in the National Tax List: "other taxes and fees" (RON 1,650.5 million) and "special fees" (RON 1,087 million).

instruments.explanation: The two lines come to RON 2,737.5 million; Eurostat books RON 1,538.4 million of them under local government and the rest, RON 1,199.1 million, under the State.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D214L C01 and C02

names.official: Tax on revenues from the transfer of real estate property from personal patrimony, State part
names.native: Impozit pe veniturile din transferul proprietăților imobiliare (partea statului)
names.common: Real estate transfer tax: State part

taxes.base: Gains from the transfer of real estate property from personal assets.

instruments.explanation: The line is RON 1,227.8 million; Eurostat books RON 486.5 million of the transaction taxes under local government and the rest under the State.

names.official: Taxes and tariffs for licences and operating permits, State part
names.native: Taxe pentru licențe și autorizații de funcționare (partea statului)

taxes.base: Licences and operating permits.

instruments.explanation: The line is RON 846.3 million; Eurostat books RON 362.6 million of the "other taxes on production" of this kind under local government.

names.official: Contributions to the Bank Deposit Guarantee Fund and National Resolution Fund, tax on mineral extraction, special tax on high-value property and other small lines
names.native: Contribuții la Fondul de garantare a depozitelor și Fondul național de rezoluție
names.common: Bank funds and other small taxes

taxes.base: The National Resolution Fund (RON 190 million), the Bank Deposit Guarantee Fund (RON 150 million), the tax on mineral extraction (RON 33 million), the special tax on immovable and movable property of high value (RON 15 million) and small lines.

instruments.explanation: Nine small lines.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D29H, D214J, D214D, D29A C05, D51E, D214H C06

names.official: Tax on buildings (held by legal persons and by individuals)
names.native: Impozit pe clădiri

taxes.base: Buildings: those held by legal persons (RON 4,050.6 million) and by individuals (RON 1,664.0 million), and a small building tax line.

rate.headline: Set by each local council within a range
details: The list does not give rates.

instruments.explanation: The local governments’ largest tax.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D29A C01 and C04, D59A C02

names.official: Tax on land (legal persons, individuals, land outside towns)
names.native: Impozit pe teren

taxes.base: Land held by legal persons (RON 509.9 million), land held by individuals (RON 766.3 million) and land out of town (RON 735.6 million).

rate.headline: Set by each local council within a range

instruments.explanation: Three lines.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D29A C02, D59A C01 and C03

names.official: Motor vehicle taxes (individuals and legal persons) and other taxes related to the use of goods
names.native: Impozit pe mijloacele de transport

taxes.base: Vehicles owned by individuals (RON 1,654.9 million) and legal persons (RON 735.1 million) and a line for the use of goods and authorisations (RON 189.3 million).

instruments.explanation: Eurostat books these amounts under local government.

legalRefs.locator: sheet RO, D59D C01, D29B C01 and C03

names.official: Other taxes and fees, and special fees, local part
names.native: Alte taxe și impozite locale; taxe speciale (partea autorităților locale)
names.common: Other taxes and fees: local part

taxes.base: The same two lines as the State part.

instruments.explanation: The part of the "other taxes and fees" that Eurostat’s accounts record under local government.

names.official: Tax on revenues from the transfer of real estate property, local part
names.native: Impozit pe veniturile din transferul proprietăților imobiliare (partea autorităților locale)
names.common: Real estate transfer tax: local part

taxes.base: The same line as the State part.

instruments.explanation: The part of the line that Eurostat’s accounts record under local government.

names.official: Taxes and tariffs for licences and operating permits, local part
names.native: Taxe pentru licențe și autorizații (partea autorităților locale)

taxes.base: The same line as the State part.

instruments.explanation: The part of the line that Eurostat’s accounts record under local government.

names.official: Stamp taxes, taxes on specific services, hotel and entertainment taxes and other taxes and fees on individuals
names.native: Taxa de timbru; taxa hotelieră; taxa pe spectacole
names.common: Stamp, hotel, entertainment and other local taxes

taxes.base: Stamp taxes (RON 415.5 million), other taxes on specific services (RON 66.6 million), taxes related to hotel activity (RON 11 million), the tax on entertainment (RON 20 million) and other taxes and fees on individuals (RON 133.6 million).

instruments.explanation: Six lines.
